code: e = declare_sub_playlist(currentLine, pl_url, &attribs, sub_playlist, playlist, in_stream);
note: The HLS playlist line containing the input-controlled satip URL is accepted as a playlist element and passed forward for source loading.
The playlist element URL is used as the DASH/HLS segment source name when the demuxer locates an input filter for the segment.
The segment URL retains the satip scheme, so RTP input SATIP initialization is selected for the input-controlled string.
The loop is bounded only by the input URL length and delimiter search, not by the 1024-byte local text buffer capacity.
With a SATIP host longer than the local text array, copying each host byte writes past the end of the stack buffer.
